package.name: rosbag2_dynamic_recorder_cli
package.description:
`ros2 dynrec`: command line control of a running rosbag2_dynamic_recorder.
Built before any richer GUI on purpose. A service API is only as good as the thinnest client that can drive it, and a CLI is the one you can call from a supervisor node, a launch file, or an ssh session with no display -- which is the access pattern that matters on a robot.
Finds the recorder by looking for a node offering ~/get_status of our own type, so with one running there is nothing to configure: `ros2 dynrec status` just works. Every verb exits non-zero when the recorder refuses, so a script can rely on the exit code alone.
